# Copilot instructions

- Do not require or run Git commands before making code changes. Inspect the relevant files and make the requested changes directly; use Git commands only when they are necessary for the task.
- Do not run a build after completing code changes unless explicitly requested or needed to diagnose a specific issue.
- Follow the form validation conventions in [form-validation.instructions.md](./instructions/form-validation.instructions.md) when creating or changing form validation.
